body:
Required before the `Store`, `Board`, `Server` and `Index` splits. Needs a decision amending D-187 point 3, which refuses selecting `impl` rows and nested methods directly; that decision is the human's before work starts.

**Do.**
- Accept a chosen `impl` block, or a set of methods from one `impl`, and move them into an `impl` of the same type in another module of the crate.
- Keep identity and revision unless the text changes.
- Carry the imports the moved code needs; drop imports only staying code uses; alias a name that clashes in the target.
- Adjust visibility of fields the moved methods use without widening the public API (`pub(crate)` or accessors).
- Take along tests that reach only the moved methods; refuse a test that also reaches staying code (`E5002`).
- Rewrite references and roll back every row, file and history entry on cargo failure.
- Refuse an ambiguous or missing owner with a clear error.

**Tests.** Inherent method move; trait-impl method move; a set of methods from one impl; private field access across modules; import carrying and aliasing; test moves; cargo failure rollback; no new warnings.

**Out of scope.** Cross-project Rust `extract`; Rust `merge`; converting an existing inline test container (task:850a33d7aff739db handles test files).
title: extract: Rust impl and method moves
